---
title: "FDI Restrictions for Thee But Not for Me"
date: "2012-06-22"
categories: ["Economics", "Foreign Investment"]
---

Qantas is [lobbying politicians](http://m.smh.com.au/business/we-could-go-under-qantas-tells-mps-20120621-20r1y.html) for FDI restrictions to prevent Etihad from acquiring Virgin or to ease the foreign ownership restrictions in the Qantas Sale Act. Australia’s Hansonite political class will likely choose the former over the latter, at least in the short-run. In the long-run, however, the government will probably have to choose between a majority foreign-owned Qantas or taking Qantas back into public ownership as a loss-making ward of the state.
